settings.title: 1% for the Planet
settings.body: We're proud members of 1% for the Planet, committing 1% of annual revenue to approved environmental nonprofits.

settings.title: Cascades Land Trust
settings.body: A portion of every sale supports the Cascades Land Trust's work protecting old-growth corridors and wildlife habitat.

settings.title: Sustainable Materials
settings.body: We source organic cotton, recycled polyester, and Tencel from mills with verified environmental and labor standards.
